sample_inclusion: 3 sedentary + 3 exercised LV per sex, n=12 (S1.7.p1, FIG6 legend)
primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week moderate treadmill endurance exercise on LV gene expression, estimated separately within each sex (exercised vs sedentary)
planned_contrasts: Female EX vs Female Sed (FIG6B/C; S2.5.p2: 1 DEG, Ddx3y up in EX)
Male EX vs Male Sed (FIG6B/D; S2.5.p2: 22 DEGs)
Female vs Male within Sed (FIG7; 896 DEGs) and within EX (174 DEGs) -- sex comparisons, not exercise estimands
repeated_measure_unit: none for RNA-seq (one heart per mouse)
paper_method: DESeq2 Wald test, BH-adjusted p (S1.8.p3), per-sex exercised vs sedentary comparison

paper_threshold.source_locator: S1.8.p3 (Padj < 0.05; log2FC cutoff 0 for volcano/KEGG; 2 only for top-gene plots); FIG6 legend

paper_direction_convention: log2FC = Sedentary minus Exercised (S1.7.p1); positive = up in Sed. Our tables use EX vs SED (positive = up in EX).
